description: The old Entra record is deleted only in retire_instance_record() (ADR-0063); the same delete anywhere else is refused.

patches.replace:
if [ "$target" = environment ]; then retire_instance_record "$app_env"; fi
  if az deployment group delete --name "$entra_name" --resource-group "$instance_rg" --only-show-errors --output none 2> "$err"; then :; fi
